_amendment_8_1b: Eighth relay, unanimous 8.1(b) (REVIEW_LOG 2026-08-11): measurement-side amendment after the frozen procedure failed to transport to the instruct checkpoint (calibration evidence: followon-instruct/calibration-instruct.json, diagnostic-traces.jsonl). answer_extraction_rule: frozen 'ANSWER: <int|none>' regex (last match) takes precedence; if and only if no ANSWER line exists, the LAST \boxed{<integer>} in the trace; nothing else accepted
